train_pacman_model: train a NavPlannerControllerModel using SGD optimizer with shared memory across multiprocessing workers
eval_pacman_model: evaluate a NavPlannerControllerModel on validation or test splits with navigation and VQA metrics
run_train_and_eval: run training and evaluation simultaneously using multiprocessing with one eval process and N train processes
load_nav_checkpoint: load a saved navigation model checkpoint from a .pt file and restore model state and args
compute_navigation_metrics: compute navigation metrics including distance to target, success rate, and episode length at multiple initialization steps
